title: Following the execution
lead: Follow one request from the user’s question to the final answer.

sections.title: Without tools
sections.body:
Call generate() → prepare instructions and messages → request the model → return the result.
The previous lesson configured no tools. Its agent cannot fetch live data through tools and does not execute code appearing in its answer.

sections.title: With tools
sections.body:
The model returns a tool name and arguments → the program validates and executes the tool → the result goes back to the model → generation continues.
One task can involve multiple model calls and tool executions. The application supplies tools; the model can only request exposed capabilities.

sections.title: Ask three questions
sections.body:
Did this information come from the user, the model, or a tool result?
Did this step generate text or execute code?
Why did the task stop here, and where did a failure occur?

note: For the order example, mark each step as model generation or application code execution. Then consider what should happen if the order lookup times out.
